name: MessagesPlus
author: Dominik
description: Inbox hygiene for the vanilla Messages app: customer-only Clear All + Clear Read, live name AND message-text search, category filter chips (Customer/Dealer/Supplier) and an unread counter — plus a one-time legacy restore that un-hides threads deleted by MessagesPlus v0.1.x. Dark mode is permanent; the theme sync now re-applies every second and themes selectable-backed surfaces directly.
